        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);

    static void solve(int n, BufferedReader br, PrintWriter pw) throws IOException {
        int k = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        double[] p = new double[n];
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i] = Double.parseDouble(st.nextToken());
        }

        double[][] dp = new double[2][1 << n];
        Arrays.fill(dp[0], 0);
        Arrays.fill(dp[1], 0);

        boolean[] isgood = new boolean[n];
        List<Integer> good = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (p[i] != 0) {
                isgood[i] = true;
                good.add(i);
            }
        }

        dp[0][0] = 1;
        int c = 1;

        double[] sum = new double[1 << n];
        sum[0] = 1.0;
        for (int j = 1; j < (1 << n); j++) {
            int x = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(j);
            sum[j] = sum[j ^ (1 << x)] - p[x];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(good.size(), k); i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dp[c], 0);

            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) != i) continue;

                for (int next : good) {
                    if (((j >> next) & 1) == 0) {
                        dp[c][j ^ (1 << next)] += dp[c ^ 1][j] * p[next] / sum[j];
                    }
                }
            }

            c ^= 1;
        }

        c ^= 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!isgood[i]) {
                pw.printf("%.12f ", 0);
            } else {
                double ans = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                    if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                        ans += dp[c][j];
                    }
                }
                pw.printf("%.12f ", ans);
            }
            pw.println();
        }
    }
}
